description: Fix bugs and implement a real working RAG pipeline with proper embeddings, improved chunking, and actual answer generation logic. Replace the hash-based placeholder embedding with TF-IDF vectorization that works without external API keys. Implement proper answer synthesis from retrieved chunks.
steps: Update pyproject.toml to add dependencies: scikit-learn (for TF-IDF vectorization), numpy. Keep requires-python as >=3.11.

Create app/embeddings.py - Implement a TF-IDF based embedding system: (1) A VectorizerStore singleton that maintains a TfidfVectorizer fitted on all indexed documents. (2) An embed() function that converts text to a dense vector using TF-IDF with SVD dimensionality reduction (128 dims). (3) A refit() function called after new chunks are added to update the vectorizer. (4) Fallback: if only one document exists, use the existing hash-based approach until enough corpus is available.

Update app/pipeline.py - (1) Improve chunk_document() to use overlapping sliding window chunking (chunk_size=512 chars, overlap=100 chars) instead of just splitting on double newlines. Keep paragraph tracking. (2) Remove the old hash-based embed() function. (3) Improve parse_content() to handle edge cases better (empty files, binary files that slip through).

Create app/answer_engine.py - Implement answer synthesis: (1) A generate_answer(query, chunks, max_chunks=5) function that constructs a well-formatted answer from retrieved chunks using extractive summarization (select most relevant sentences from chunks). (2) A generate_followups(query, chunks) function that suggests follow-up questions based on what was found. (3) A compute_confidence(scores) function that returns a meaningful confidence score based on retrieval score distribution.

Update app/store.py - (1) Add a method reindex_embeddings(project_id) that re-embeds all chunks for a project when the vectorizer is refitted. (2) Fix the ensure_project_access method to handle missing project gracefully with proper HTTP-friendly errors.

Update app/main.py query endpoint - (1) Replace the simple snippet concatenation with the new answer_engine.generate_answer(). (2) Use the new embedding system for query embedding. (3) Use generate_followups() for follow-up suggestions. (4) Use compute_confidence() for confidence scores. (5) Fix the scoring threshold - currently 0.08 is arbitrary, use dynamic threshold based on score distribution (e.g., mean - 1 std dev of top scores).
Update app/main.py ingest endpoint - After adding chunks, call refit on the embedding system and reindex existing chunks so TF-IDF stays current.

Fix bug: In main.py upload_file(), the PermissionError from ensure_project_access should be caught properly (currently it raises generic PermissionError but the endpoint catches it correctly - verify this works end-to-end).
Fix deprecation: Replace all datetime.utcnow() calls with datetime.now(datetime.UTC) throughout the codebase (models.py, main.py, store.py).
acceptance_criteria: python3.12 -m pip install -e '.[dev]' succeeds with new dependencies
The embed() function produces meaningful vectors where semantically similar texts have higher cosine similarity than unrelated texts
The query endpoint returns synthesized answers (not just concatenated snippets) when chunks are available
Chunking uses overlapping windows so no information is lost at boundaries
All existing tests still pass (may need updates to work with new embedding approach)
